item.title: Bahamas Sailing Series: Your Guide to Yacht Adventures in the Exumas & Abacos
item.description: Welcome to the Dream Yacht’s Bahamas Series We’re kicking off our Dream Bahamas Series—a collection of blogs dedicated to helping you explore the very best of the Bahamas by yacht. Dream Yacht offers access to two incredible sailing destinations: the Exumas and the Abacos. Each is distinct in personality and beauty, and we’ll be diving into both in the coming weeks. If you’re dreaming of a tropical getaway that combines adventure, relaxation, and incredible wildlife, look no further than a yacht charter in the Bahamas. This is the first blog in our Bahamas series, where we’ll explore everything these sun-soaked islands have to offer — from iconic anchorages to hidden gems only accessible by boat. With over 700 islands and countless cays, the Bahamas offers an idyllic setting for sailors and vacationers alike. From curated cruising itineraries and insider insights to local tips, travel logistics, and can’t-miss experiences, this series is your go-to guide for planning the ultimate Bahamian escape. Whether you’re dreaming of shallow turquoise anchorages or charming island settlements, we’re here to deliver inspiration and practical advice to make your sailing adventure unforgettable. Stay tuned for more—and let the voyage begin! Why Charter a Yacht in The Bahamas? While the Bahamas are often associated with commercial cruises and bustling resorts, there’s a more intimate, authentic side waiting to be discovered. Imagine trading the crowds and cookie-cutter experiences for quiet harbors, vibrant local settlements, and the freedom to explore at your own pace. A private yacht charter lets you escape the ordinary and sail these phenomenal islands in comfort. Snorkel vibrant coral reefs teeming with marine life, stroll along untouched white-sand beaches, and dive into crystal-clear turquoise waters—all from the deck of your own floating sanctuary. Experience this family’s unforgettable journey through the Exumas, where they embraced the island’s laid-back charm and the breathtakingly blue waters. Discover the Exumas: A Chain of Hidden Gems The Exumas, a stunning chain of 365 cays, are renowned for their crystal-clear waters and pristine beaches just 35 miles south of Nassau. Departing from Nassau, this adventure takes you to iconic spots like Big Major Cay, home to the famous swimming pigs, and Compass Cay, where you can swim with friendly nurse sharks. Snorkeling enthusiasts will revel in the vibrant marine life at Thunderball Grotto, featured in the James Bond movie “Thunderball.” See the top excursions for this destination here . Many of these treasures can only be accessed by boat, making a yacht charter the best choice to explore these expansive waters. Learn More About The Exumas Explore the Abacos: Where Tranquility Meets Island Charm Set your course for the Abacos, a charming and easy-to-navigate chain of islands and barrier cays in the northern Bahamas. Known for their historic colonial towns, calm turquoise waters, and relaxed Caribbean vibe, the Abacos offer a sailing experience that’s as serene as it is unforgettable. Get an inside look at this traveler’s recent adventure through the Abacos here . Cruise past pastel-painted villages, anchor in sheltered harbors, and stroll through quaint settlements like Hope Town and Green Turtle Cay. This region is a haven for those seeking simplicity and authenticity—where every island brings a new horizon and every sunset feels like your own private show. Whether you’re sailing with a skipper or captaining your own vessel, the Abacos promise unspoiled beauty, rich culture, and the freedom to explore on your own terms. Learn More About The Abacos Charter Options to Suit Every Traveler in the Bahamas Dream Yacht caters to all levels of experience: Bareboat Charter : Ideal for seasoned sailors wanting the freedom to navigate the islands at their own pace. item.title: Sail the Med in style: New Excess catamarans available for charter
item.description: As the summer season approaches, Mediterranean sailing beckons with its crystal-clear waters, stunning landscapes, and rich cultural heritage. What better way to experience the Med than on a brand-new Excess Catamaran, perfectly designed for a sailing vacation of a lifetime? We have sparkling new fresh-from-the-factory Excess Catamarans arriving, and we’re excited to offer them for charter in some of the most amazing destinations in the Mediterranean, including Montenegro, the French Riviera, and Croatia. Get to know Excess sailing catamarans These sleek and stylish Excess 14 and Excess 11 catamarans are just a few of the latest exciting additions to our Dream Yacht fleet, and they’re packed with features that make them perfect for sailors and those looking to explore the best of the Mediterranean from aboard a new, thoughtfully-designed Excess charter yacht. If you haven’t sailed aboard an Excess Catamaran before, you’re in for a treat. Excess yachts place a special design emphasis on a satisfying sailing experience, with exceptional responsiveness at the helm and heightened sailing “sensations”. Excess achieves an excellent level of onboard comfort as well – but not at the expense of performance. Meet the Excess 14 & Excess 11 The recently released Excess 14 is gaining momentum with sailing enthusiasts for its substantial 46-ft length offering uniquely nimble handling, reduced drag and improved stability. The Dream Yacht charter version features 4-cabins and 4-baths with plenty of space for a larger group of Mediterranean adventurers. The smaller Excess 11 is 37-ft of sailing fun. It’s perfect for small groups and families to explore the Mediterranean, with 4 comfortable cabins and 2 baths. For those newer to sailing it’s designed for ease of sailing, with excellent visibility and self-tacking jib. More experienced sailors will appreciate the lively helm and thrilling sailing sensations. Both models feature the latest technology and innovations from Excess, including a sleek and modern design, a large cockpit with a sliding glass door, and a spacious salon with plenty of natural light. They are also equipped with a range of amenities, including air conditioning, generator, and watermaker, ensuring a comfortable and convenient sailing experience. Whether you’re an experienced sailor or just starting out, the Excess 14 and Excess 11 catamarans are sure to impress. Their combination of performance, comfort, and style makes them the perfect choice for a Med charter vacation. The new Excess 13 In addition to the Excess 11 and 14, Excess has announced that their newest catamaran offering will be announced at the upcoming La Grand Motte boat show this spring. The exciting new Excess 13 is a sleek, dependable and lively sailboat – a perfect charter vacation platform. Watch for arrivals into the Dream Yacht Charter fleet soon! Charter a New Excess 14 – Trogir, Croatia Trogir, located on the Dalmatian coast of Croatia, is a historic town surrounded by a stunning archipelago, with countless islands, bays, and beaches to explore – the perfect starting point for your Croatia sailing charter . Trogir is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, with a rich history dating back to the ancient Greeks and Romans. The town’s narrow streets and picturesque piazzas are filled with historic landmarks, including the stunning Trogir Cathedral and the Kamerlengo Fortress. The surrounding islands, such as the famed Hvar and Brač, offer a range of sailing opportunities, from secluded beaches to vibrant ports and harbors. Our new Excess 14 catamaran is available for charters from our base in Trogir, Croatia beginning June 14, 2025 offering the perfect opportunity to experience the best of Croatia’s sailing scene. Plan now and grab your chance at summer sailing aboard this brand new Dream Yacht “Super Premiere” sailing catamaran.
